rule: Every move has a positive quantity and a different destination
Every move is explained in one line
Stores only give stock they physically hold (not in transit, not suspect counts)
Warehouses never send more than on hand + inbound due
No receiving store ends above its capacity
Giving stores stay at or above minimum display per category
Protected styles are never given away
No store-to-store refill leaves the giver under 30 days of style cover
Stock in transit is counted: nothing is sent beyond need
No store both gives and receives the same SKU
Lines above ₹1.0 L at MRP are flagged for approval
Every optional line pays for its own freight and handling
Every trip without a rule-driven line earns more than it costs
Returns stay within 25 pieces and ₹1.5 L per store per run
Refills never strip the last core size from a giver's active option
Nothing is refilled after its season ends
Outlets are never refilled or used as donors
